title: Scalar feature averages equal their Bochner L² means
source_anchor: Samplinglib original mathematical supplement v1, 2026-10-20; units[3] and its complete formula proof
target_statement: Under the same finite-dimensional real inner-product, Borel and finite-polynomial assumptions, let Φ(w) be the actual L² class of x↦p(⟨w,x⟩) under the standard Gaussian γ. The feature membership witnesses are produced together with continuity of Φ. For every probability law ρ on the unit sphere, the scalar feature is genuinely integrable in w for every fixed x, and Φ is genuinely Bochner integrable under ρ. The literal scalar-average function x↦∫p(⟨w,x⟩) dρ(w) belongs to L²(γ), and its actual L² class equals ∫Φ dρ. All membership, measurability and integral-exchange obligations are conclusions of the theorem.
